title: Flimsy
text: Flimsy. Unfortunately this is a failed experiment. I was hoping to use it in my guest closet where I store vacuum bags and parts. Kind of get everything together and off the floor.  This has a good Velcro strap at the top that fits over your rod or rail. That isn't the problem. The problem is the "shelves" themselves have not sturdiness. They are just cardboard and as soon as you start to put things on them, they bend. I didn't get more than a pack of bags and 2 brushes on it when the combined weight caused it to sag. I'm not sure what this would be intended for. Maybe ballet slippers, but not much more.
